annotations.title: Check a USB Type-C sink's CC terminations

description: Check a USB-C powered device's CC pins against the USB Type-C specification's termination values: each CC pin's pull-down against 5.1 kohm (within 10% to read a current advertisement, within 20% for default power only), one resistor per CC pin, and whether the current the board draws is within what the source offered (default USB power, a 1.5 A / 3 A advertisement the board reads, or a negotiated Power Delivery contract). Optionally decodes a measured CC voltage into the source's advertisement. The reference values are returned with the answer. It does NOT read a Power Delivery controller's configuration, and does not check VBUS protection, ESD parts or data routing. Free with a DatasheetVend API key (no credits), no model call, reads no account data, stores nothing.

board_current_a.description: The most current the board draws from VBUS at 5 V.

data_role.description: Sets default USB power: 0.5 A for usb2 (default), 0.9 A for usb3.

resistor_tolerance_pct.description: The resistors' own tolerance: 1 for a 1% part.
